summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of FieldDesk Dispatch page mobile responsiveness and framer-motion animations. All 16 features tested successfully. Desktop three-panel layout, shop sidebar animations, ProductDetail views, and locked features work correctly. Mobile bottom nav, shop overlay with spring animation, responsive grids, and header hiding all function as expected.

ui_bugs.issue: DEMO MODE badge (fixed position, z-50) overlaps with Shop toggle button in header on desktop, intercepting clicks. Users can still click via JavaScript or by clicking the non-overlapped portion. This is a known LOW priority issue from iteration_1.

seed_data_creation: None required - demo mode uses hardcoded values
context_for_next_testing_agent: All FieldDesk Dispatch features tested and working. Mobile responsiveness verified at 390x844 viewport. Desktop verified at 1920x800 viewport. Framer-motion animations working correctly for shop sidebar (width animation), tab content (fade+translateY), and mobile shop overlay (spring animation from right).
